create_reaction_by_id: create a Reaction object by loading a specific reaction ID from the reaction database pickle file
create_reaction_by_type: create a Reaction object by randomly selecting from reactions matching a given reaction type like dissociation
create_reaction_by_string: create a Reaction object by looking up a reaction string in the reaction database pickle file
create_reaction_random: create a Reaction object by randomly selecting any reaction from the reaction database
get_desorption_mapping: get the atom index mapping for a desorption reaction by calling get_desorption_mapping on a Reaction instance
